mutations.description: Accept a modified member operation without checking its author's signature.
Accept a correctly signed author with no workspace grant in its causal history.

edits.pattern: ensure!\(\s*member,\s*"operation author is not an authorized workspace member"\s*,?\s*\);

mutations.description: Treat a different signed payload under an existing operation ID as an accepted duplicate.

edits.pattern: ensure!\(\s*previous == signed,\s*"operation identity was reused with different content"\s*,?\s*\);

mutations.description: Remove both command-head comparison and independent signed causal-head validation so a stale reconciliation is accepted.

edits.pattern: ensure!\(\s*!actual\.is_empty\(\) && expected == actual,\s*"edit does not name its causal resource heads"\s*,?\s*\);
